name: OCB
recent: OCB 近期主要出现大股东权益变动申报，涉及 PATRICIA WOON LAI CHING、YEOH JIN HOE 及 DAS O'CONNORS SDN. BHD. 的连续申报。公司于 2026 年 11 月 23 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告。
notable: 大股东 PATRICIA WOON LAI CHING、YEOH JIN HOE 及 DAS O'CONNORS SDN. BHD. 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报权益变动。
公司发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告。

news.title: Stocks with Momentum on Nov 13, 2026: Citaglobal, OCB

recent_en: OCB recently saw a series of substantial shareholder interest change filings involving PATRICIA WOON LAI CHING, YEOH JIN HOE and DAS O'CONNORS SDN. BHD. The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November 2026.
notable_en: Substantial shareholders PATRICIA WOON LAI CHING, YEOH JIN HOE and DAS O'CONNORS SDN. BHD. filed multiple interest change notices between September and October 2026.
The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
